name: program-runtime.supervision-sweep
purpose: Read fleet lifecycle state once and report running/health for a named delivery-scenario set, naming any that are not running or not healthy, so a supervisor runs one program instead of one status call per scenario.

scenarios.description: Comma-separated scenario slugs to supervise. Defaults to the delivery/product scenario set.

assumptions: the vrooli project control-plane API is reachable (the process that serves vrooli/scenario/list)
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
exactly one governed read (vrooli/scenario/list) is issued; no per-scenario fan-out
no row set is materialized beyond the requested scenario slugs
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
at most 32 requested scenarios are reported; the request is truncated with truncated=true

signals.requested: count of scenario slugs supervised after truncation
signals.found: count of requested slugs present in the fleet list
signals.running: count of requested scenarios whose lifecycle status is running
signals.healthy: count of requested scenarios whose health is healthy
signals.attention: list of {name, status, health} for requested scenarios that are not running or not healthy, plus any requested slug absent from the fleet list
signals.truncated: true when more than 32 slugs were requested

fixtures.note: Requires the project control-plane API serving vrooli/scenario/list. When that endpoint is down the program returns status unavailable with reason scenario_unreachable; that is the honest sensor result, not a program defect.
An empty scenario set after trimming is an invalid input the program reports as failed with class invalid_input before any read.
